citations.quote: Unrestricted Cash shall not be less than $3,000,000 at any month end.
"Unrestricted Cash" means cash held in deposit accounts of the Borrower with the Lender, excluding any cash that is pledged, escrowed or otherwise restricted.
Runway shall not be less than 6.0 months at any month end.
"Runway" means Unrestricted Cash divided by the average monthly Net Burn for the three months then ended; if that average is zero or negative, Runway is not meaningful and the covenant is satisfied.
"Net Burn" means, for any month, capital expenditures plus capitalized software development spend, less net cash from operating activities, and excludes the proceeds of equity and debt financing.
Revenue for any three-month period shall not be less than 80% of the Approved Plan for the same three months.

citation.quote: Within 30 days after the end of each month, the Borrower shall deliver management financial statements for that month and the year to date.
Within 30 days after the end of each month, the Borrower shall deliver a compliance certificate signed by its chief financial officer.
Within 15 days after the end of each month, the Borrower shall deliver a monthly recurring revenue report.
Within 7 days after the end of each month, the Borrower shall deliver its bank account statements for that month.
Within 180 days after the end of each fiscal year, the Borrower shall deliver audited financial statements with an unqualified opinion.

clause_index.quote: The Lender has made a venture term loan to the Borrower in the aggregate principal amount of $1,500,000, bearing interest at the rate of Prime plus 3.50 percent. The venture term loan is interest-only through December 31, 2027; no principal is scheduled before then, and principal is repayable in equal monthly installments after that date.
